page.overview:
What is Confrontation between the Aelos and the Venturous?

In around 18 BBY a brief confrontation occurred between the Aelos and the Venturous at Sposia. The confrontation ending with the Aelos launching Crippler nets at the Venturous and the Springhawk escaping with the Vagaari Gravity well projector he would later use at his last stand.
